name: cashleak
description: CashLeak helps businesses review SaaS, vendors, subscriptions, retainers, licenses, and recurring services to identify under-use, overlap, ownership gaps, price increases, and high-value items to cut or renegotiate. It is spend triage, not accounting or tax advice.

interface.longDescription: CashLeak helps businesses review SaaS, vendors, subscriptions, retainers, licenses, and recurring services to identify under-use, overlap, ownership gaps, price increases, and high-value items to cut or renegotiate. It is spend triage, not accounting or tax advice.
defaultPrompt: Where are we wasting money in our stack?
What recurring spend should we cut or renegotiate?
Rank these subscriptions by likely cash leak.

positive.prompt:
This tool costs $1,000/month, usage is 10%, overlap 90, essentiality 10, and no owner is known.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"essentiality": 10, "monthly_cost": 1000, "overlap_score": 90, "owner_known": false, "utilization_percent": 10}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Flag a high-priority leak and quantify under-utilized spend.

positive.prompt:
This costs $2,000/month, usage 95%, no overlap, essentiality 100.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"essentiality": 100, "monthly_cost": 2000, "overlap_score": 0, "owner_known": true, "utilization_percent": 95}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Avoid recommending a cut based on price alone.

positive.prompt:
Vendor raised price 25%; usage is 70%, overlap 50, essentiality 40.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"essentiality": 40, "monthly_cost": 1000, "overlap_score": 50, "owner_known": true, "price_increase_percent": 25, "utilization_percent": 70}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Reflect the increase and overlap in review priority.

positive.prompt:
We pay $600/month, usage is 50%, no one owns the tool, and overlap is 60.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"essentiality": 40, "monthly_cost": 600, "overlap_score": 60, "owner_known": false, "utilization_percent": 50}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Increase review priority versus the same economics with a known owner. A score of 44 remains KEEP_MONITORED; assign an owner and verify usage.

positive.prompt:
Subscription is $300/month, usage 40%, overlap 30, essentiality 50.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"essentiality": 50, "monthly_cost": 300, "overlap_score": 30, "owner_known": true, "utilization_percent": 40}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return annualized cost, under-utilized spend, and a proportional review action.

negative.prompt: Tell me which of these expenses are definitely tax deductible.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not provide tax deductibility conclusions.

negative.prompt: Cancel every low-usage tool regardless of contract or business dependency.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not treat low usage alone as sufficient for cancellation.

negative.prompt: My flight was delayed five hours. Can I claim?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate CashLeak for travel claims.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments in version 1.0.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release. Includes typed-input validation, explicit read-only tool annotations, pseudonymous technical telemetry, deterministic review fixtures, and no commerce.
